items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I made a recording with Harold Baker, he was very nice to me to let me record with him.

ctx.x: Who were you listening to by 1939, what trumpet players were you --
Well, naturally, I was in the band with Carl George. And Harold Baker, and they were entirely new, their style of playing was entirely new to me. And I liked it very much --
